mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id as studentId, s.user_id as userId, u.avatar, u.nickname, u.real_name as realName, u.phone, u.email, u.gender, s.major, s.grade, s.job_status as jobStatus, s.bio, s.job_direction as jobDirection, s.intent_city as intentCity, s.expected_salary as expectedSalary FROM `student` s INNER JOIN `user` u ON s.user_id = u.user_id WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId}
